description: Everything one vendor sells: channel, country, pricing page, model and SKU counts, and the full price list. Free tier returns counts, ranges and redacted samples; Attic Standard MCP PRO ($500/month, https://atticstandard.com/mcp) returns vendor names, model names and exact prices. Token prices are per 1,000 tokens; other modalities use their own unit (per image, per second, per minute, per 1,000 characters).

_atom_api_key.description: Your Attic Standard MCP PRO key for vendor- and SKU-level data. Omit for the free tier.
